schedulers.abl_v1_durations: Hybrid with the original duration model

solver_benchmark.note: Gap = shortfall from the best plan any optimiser found for that instance (full fitness). CP-SAT is time-limited and multi-threaded, so its numbers can vary slightly between runs and machines.

stability.note: Quality is the Balanced fitness without the stability term. Each case is one disruption replanned at every level from the same morning plan (paired).

pinball_difference.meaning: v2 minus v1, minutes; negative favours v2
